items.t: Bloom Energy Soars 13%, Vertiv Up 14% in a Week as Data-Center Fears Ease
items.sum: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy rose 13% in the past week, with Vertiv and Oracle, after CoreWeave and Constellation Energy raised their 2026 guidance. Bloom had no news of its own, and with its orders and rising estimates intact, the bounce looks like it has further to go.

items.t: Vertiv Introduces High-Density Remote Power Panel for Next-Generation AI Data Centers
items.sum: Vertiv Holdings Co. (NYSE: VRT), a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, today introduced the Vertiv™ PowerStation 3100 RPP, a high-density remote power panel designed to help data center operators streamline power distribution for AI and high-performance computing (HPC) racks with power densities exceeding 100 kW. The solution is available now in North America.

Vertiv Holdings Co (NYSE: VRT), a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, today announced that its Board of Directors has raised its regular annual cash dividend by 60% from $0.25 to $0.40 per share, to be declared and paid quarterly, reflecting the company's strong financial performance and cash flow.
